name: Supreme Witch, Calamitas - Official Calamity Mod Wiki
snippet: Aug 10, 2026 — Supreme Witch, Calamitas does not spawn on her own and requires the player to summon her by using Ashes of Calamity on an Altar of the Accursed. Read more

name: Rancor - Calamity Mod Wiki - Fandom
snippet: Rancor is a Godseeker Mode magic weapon . It is the exhumed form of the Burning Sea. It creates a magic circle a set distance away from the player.
